policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="listBackends" value="@{
                    JArray backends = new JArray();
                    
                    // Backend 1
                    backends.Add(new JObject()
                    {
                        { "url", "wss://.cognitiveservices.azure.com/openai/realtime" },
                        { "priority", 1 },
                        { "isThrottling", false },
                        { "retryAfter", DateTime.MinValue }
                    });
                    
                    // Backend 2 - 请替换为你的第二个后端
                    backends.Add(new JObject()
                    {
                        { "url", "wss://.cognitiveservices.azure.com/openai/realtime" },
                        { "priority", 1 },
                        { "isThrottling", false },
                        { "retryAfter", DateTime.MinValue }
                    });
                    
                    return backends;
                }" />
                
            
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
            @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["managed-id-access-token"])
        
        
        
            
            
            
        
        
        <set-variable name="selectedBackendInfo" value="@{
            JArray backends = (JArray)context.Variables["listBackends"];
            
            // 安全地获取当前索引
            int currentIndex = 0;
            if (context.Variables.ContainsKey("roundRobinIndex"))
            {
                object idxObj = context.Variables["roundRobinIndex"];
                if (idxObj is int)
                {
                    currentIndex = (int)idxObj;
                }
            }
            
            // 更新过期的 throttling 状态
            for (int i = 0; i < backends.Count; i++)
            {
                JObject backend = (JObject)backends[i];
                if (backend.Value("isThrottling") && DateTime.Now >= backend.Value("retryAfter"))
                {
                    backend["isThrottling"] = false;
                    backend["retryAfter"] = DateTime.MinValue;
                }
            }
            
            // 收集所有健康的后端
            List healthyBackends = new List();
            for (int i = 0; i < backends.Count; i++)
            {
                if (!((JObject)backends[i]).Value("isThrottling"))
                {
                    healthyBackends.Add(i);
                }
            }
            
            // 如果有健康的后端，使用轮询选择
            if (healthyBackends.Count > 0)
            {
                // 轮询：选择下一个健康的后端
                int selectedIdx = healthyBackends[currentIndex % healthyBackends.Count];
                
                // 更新轮询索引
                currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % healthyBackends.Count;
                
                JObject selected = (JObject)backends[selectedIdx];
                return new JObject()
                {
                    { "url", selected.Value("url") },
                    { "index", selectedIdx },
                    { "nextRoundRobinIndex", currentIndex }
                };
            }
            
            // 如果所有都在 throttling，使用第一个
            return new JObject()
            {
                { "url", ((JObject)backends[0]).Value("url") },
                { "index", 0 },
                { "nextRoundRobinIndex", 0 }
            };
        }" />
        
        <cache-store-value key="@("roundRobinIndex-" + context.Api.Id)" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackendInfo"]).Value("nextRoundRobinIndex").ToString())" duration="60" />
        
        <set-variable name="selectedBackendUrl" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackendInfo"]).Value("url"))" />
        <set-variable name="selectedBackendIndex" value="@(((JObject)context.Variables["selectedBackendInfo"]).Value("index"))" />
